claims.summary: The package sourceRef bridge counts only trusted source rows that are linked to course concepts.
CourseIR atom coverage can only replace review proof when multiple trusted, concept-linked source rows exist.
Source-ledger summaries expose concept-linked and trusted-concept-linked counts so export, report, and grader surfaces agree.
Package-export and source-quality regressions prove unlinked trusted metadata remains review-visible without inflating sourceRef coverage.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify trusted, concept-linked source rows reach manifest, source report, and CourseIR sourceRef coverage.
If source points remain below target, inspect retrieval failure, source-finder attachment loss during repair, or insufficient trusted concept-linked rows.
Improve slide-deck substance and deterministic texture variation until a fresh package honestly reaches 100/100.
